symbols.name: Retryer

findings.detail: math/rand.Rand is explicitly documented as not safe for concurrent use. If the same Retryer handles concurrent retry loops (a common pattern), simultaneous calls to NextDelay/Wait race on rng. Fix: add a sync.Mutex field to Retryer and lock around rng access, or replace rng with a sync-safe source.
